capture_content.description: Capture response and request bodies when CDP makes them available.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum decoded bytes retained for any one response body.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of HAR entries retained by the recording.

max_total_body_bytes.description: Maximum decoded response-body bytes retained by the recording.

sanitize.description: Redact credentials in headers and common sensitive query parameters.

tab_id.description: Optional target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.
